decision: Can a uniformly randomized 12-root shield-bounded intention create enough exactly attributed intention-to-treat physical-HIT support for a later serial training collection?

hypotheses.H1_target_alignment: The learner decision is the randomized group-start intention, not a one-frame action. Its factual label is physical HIT within the following 12 unit-frame transitions and before any next randomized assignment; shield overrides and fail-closed input release are deterministic parts of that intention protocol.
hypotheses.H2_exposure: At least 70% of eligible complete groups have no shield override and at least 12 witnessed intended-action executions.
hypotheses.H3_support: Each complete Stage 4 episode contains at least 1800 eligible 12-root groups, and every canonical action receives at least 100 randomized assignments across the two pilot-train episodes.
hypotheses.H4_safety: Every published root remains inside its freshly recomputed observed-shield set. An inadmissible intention publishes the current reactive baseline; an unsafe input already in the pickup lease remains a fail-closed control dead-end.
hypotheses.H5_selection_limit: Passing the collection contract with at least 16 accepted HIT-positive group starts selects only a separately frozen serial training collection. It does not admit parallel Wine, a model, value learning, a learned policy, or a gameplay claim.

sizing_evidence.scope: read-only factual continuations from immutable L2d and L2k episodes; no counterfactual successor and no fit
sizing_evidence.selection_reason: Twelve roots is the shortest measured horizon near event-support saturation: extending to 16 adds one upper-bound positive while removing about 25% of group starts and lowering factual mask persistence.
sizing_evidence.parallel_boundary: The immutable E5 serial/concurrent traces first diverge at schedule-dependent observation gaps after matching RNG, policy, shield, action, and physical facts. The polling-to-NtSuspendProcess window has no root handshake. Exact parallel collection remains rejected; L2l is serial.

target.positive: a physical HIT occurs within 12 contiguous unit-frame transitions after assignment and before any next randomized assignment
target.negative: the same assignment group records exact exposure steps 0 through 11 over 12 contiguous unit-frame transitions with no physical HIT
censor: episode ends before the complete factual window
any transition has elapsed_frames other than one
the assigned action is not witnessed on the first transition
a new randomized assignment begins before the outcome boundary
an incomplete protocol reaches neither HIT nor a complete negative window
target.shield_override_semantics: intention-to-treat mediator retained in the primary target and reported separately; it is not relabeled as execution of the intended action
target.control_dead_end_semantics: deterministic protocol outcome retained when a HIT occurs before a new assignment; otherwise an incomplete dead-end group is censored

collection.stop_rule: collect both fixed slots; retain every physical HIT; reject and retry only infrastructure-invalid or Bomb-bearing attempts; stop incomplete after three infrastructure attempts for either slot

pilot_data_use: train-only after a passing collection contract; never evaluation or promotion evidence
non_goals: no learned actor, hazard model, critic, IQL, CQL, OPE, history encoder, object encoder, calibration, or learner fit
no counterfactual successor, ECL interpreter, future-birth envelope, shield widening, route logic, stage pattern rule, RNG input, or source identity
no physical-HIT retry, stop-on-hit output, Bomb, accelerated clock, parallel Wine, native root-handshake change, adaptive collection, or result peeking
no claim that the intended action executed after a shield override or control dead-end; the estimand is assignment to the full declared intention protocol
